name: harness-update
description: Updates the agent harnesses arbitron drives (claude, codex, pi, opencode) to their latest release, each through its own updater. Every harness is attempted; the run fails if any update failed. pi and opencode are deferred while running, since npm replaces them in place under a live agent. Scheduled daily at 05:00 local.
author: arbitron

nodes.label: Update harnesses
nodes.description: claude update, codex update, pi update --self, opencode upgrade; reports before/after versions per harness.
